title: kube-res-foresight
description: History and trend, algorithm ranking and runs, scaling records and operator state.

panels.title: Modules enabled
panels.description: Modules the platform forecasts.

panels.title: Datasources down
panels.description: Datasources whose last probe failed.

panels.title: Stale recommendations
panels.description: Modules whose latest recommendation has expired.

panels.title: Failing modules
panels.description: Modules whose forecast cycle failed last time.

panels.title: Failed jobs (24h)
panels.description: Jobs of the task center that failed in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Operator errors (5m)
panels.description: Requests of the operator to the platform that failed in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: History and forecast · $metric
panels.description: One panel per forecast metric (CPU in cores, memory in bytes, rps in requests per second): the newest collected value scraped over time is the history and its trend; the forecast peak is the highest value the forecast expects over its horizon, by algorithm. Compare them to see how far above the load the forecast sits.

panels.title: Recommended values
panels.description: What each recommendation set: replicas, CPU and memory requests.

panels.title: Age of the newest sample
panels.description: How old the newest collected sample is. A line that keeps rising means collection has stopped.

panels.title: Age of the newest recommendation
panels.description: Time since the platform last recommended for the module.

panels.title: Algorithm leaderboard (composite score)
panels.description: Latest composite score of every algorithm of every module (0-100, higher is better).

panels.title: Error ranking (WAPE, lowest first)
panels.description: Measured weighted absolute percentage error of the predictions once the actuals arrived. Lower is better.

panels.title: Peak underestimation (lowest first)
panels.description: How far under the real peak the forecast peak fell. This is the number that decides whether capacity runs short.

panels.title: Algorithm in use and its numbers
panels.description: Every algorithm with its score; Selected is 1 for the one the module uses.

panels.title: Backtest results
panels.description: The newest backtest of every algorithm: error, peak underestimation and whether it was promoted.

panels.title: Prediction runs by result
panels.description: Prediction runs: ok, skipped (not enough history) or failed.

panels.title: Prediction runs by algorithm
panels.description: Which algorithms run, and how their runs end.

panels.title: Prediction time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time one algorithm took to forecast.

panels.title: Collections by result
panels.description: History collections from the datasources.

panels.title: Backtests by result
panels.description: Backtests: promoted, rejected, skipped or failed.

panels.title: Scored predictions / recommendations
panels.description: Predictions scored against actuals, and recommendations made (ok, degraded, oom_floor).

panels.title: Task center jobs (last 24h)
panels.description: Jobs the task center created in the last 24 hours, by type and status.

panels.title: Fallbacks of recommendations
panels.description: Fields of a recommendation that did not come from a usable forecast.

panels.title: Replicas: desired / current / ready
panels.description: What the operator wants, what the workload has, and how many Pods are ready.

panels.title: Replicas in the scaling records (platform)
panels.description: Desired, current and ready replicas as the operator reported them to the platform (the scaling records page), newest of the last day.

panels.title: Scaling actions by direction and result
panels.description: Scale-ups and scale-downs the operator applied, failed or only observed.

panels.title: Scaling records reported (24h)
panels.description: Reports the operator sent to the platform in the last 24 hours (the scaling records page).

panels.title: Module state of the operator
panels.description: normal, cached, holding, degraded or recovering as of the newest report, and how long ago that report was.

panels.title: Decision: validity and age
panels.description: Age of the decision the operator follows and the time until it expires; negative means expired.

panels.title: Operator -> platform requests
panels.description: Requests of the operator to the platform; errors mean the platform could not be reached.

panels.title: Decision source and cache
panels.description: Where decisions came from (platform, cache, holding, fallback) and how old a remembered decision is while the platform is away.

panels.title: Reports waiting to be delivered
panels.description: Scaling reports kept while the platform was away, and reports dropped.

panels.title: Reconciles and conflicts
panels.description: Evaluations of the modules by result, and evaluations skipped because HPA or KEDA controls the target.
